capabilities: Group multiple images and videos into one browseable gallery block
Number items as figures and add captions by double-clicking
Insert figure references in text that scroll to the target figure
Reorder images by dragging thumbnails in and out of the gallery
Generate small on-the-fly thumbnails so full files load only on open
extras: A gallery is a fenced code block containing a JSON list, so images remain normal vault files and the note degrades to a plain code block without the plugin. Optional integration behavior depends on Editor Enhancer and Section Blocks. UI is available in English and Chinese.
intentEvidence: Coming from Lite Gallery? Put the cursor in a litegal block and run Convert Lite Gallery
problem: Long runs of embedded images make notes hard to scroll and sluggish with large camera photos, and Obsidian has no figure numbering or in-text figure references.

relations.evidence: Coming from Lite Gallery? Put the cursor in a litegal block and run Convert Lite Gallery
Editor Enhancer: drag the whole gallery like any other block.
Section Blocks: files dropped into a gallery are saved in a <note name> media folder

summary: Image gallery plugin that groups images and videos into one interactive block with numbered figures, captions, references, and draggable thumbnails.
